description: A C# unit test class for testing AWS DynamoDB membership table functionality within the Orleans framework. It includes tests for CRUD operations, gateway retrieval, and concurrency scenarios.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipTableTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AWS DynamoDB membership table operations in Orleans, testing CRUD, gateway retrieval, and concurrency.
